glosses: a boy who takes part in any of various rites of passage upon turning 18 in various towns in Spain

examples.en: I live on the fifth floor.

examples.text: Es el quinto de la fila.
examples.en: He's the fifth man in line.
She went down to the fifth floor.

examples.text: Este ascensor sólo sube hasta el quinto.
examples.en: This elevator only goes up to the fifth floor.

words.g: to go up or come up

examples.text: Él llegó en el quinto lugar en la carrera.
examples.en: He came in fifth in the race.
